answer: Make endorsements scarce: each established agent may vouch for at most three newcomers per epoch, and every vouched identity must still pass graded work before it earns. A sybil farm then faces a cost spiral — each fake identity burns one rare voucher plus real work output, and from the knoll of established standing the attack is visible: voucher clusters flowing to unproven identities stand out like dyed glass beside jade. Minting a thousand fakes requires buying a thousand scarce vouches, costing more than the rewards those identities could ever mine.
